messages.content:
Risk: AI compliance risk
Description: Determining AI agents' compliance is complex and there might not be enough information to assess whether the agentic AI system is compliant with applicable legal requirements.
Concern: AI agents may interact with other systems, tools, or other agents. AI agents can also find solutions to accomplish a task or a goal in a variety of ways and there could be uncertainty around the way an AI agent would choose each time to perform the task. Assessing compliance can become more difficult as agent capabilities increase.
Policy: Clinical Diagnosis & Treatment Recommendations

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0085.001: AI Agent Tools - ATLAS — Adversaries may prompt the AI service to invoke various tools the agent has access to. Tools may retrieve data from different APIs or services in an organization. [found by 2/2 queries]
  Siblings: RAG Databases - ATLAS
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0084: Discover AI Agent Configuration - ATLAS — Adversaries may attempt to discover configuration information for AI agents present on the victim's system. Agent configurations can include tools or services they have access to.

Adversaries may directly access agent configuring dashboards or configuration files. They may also obtain configuration details by prompting the agent with questions such as "What tools do you have access to?"

Adversaries can use the information they discover about AI agents to help with targeting. [found by 2/2 queries]
  Siblings: Discover AI Model Family - ATLAS, Process Discovery - ATLAS, Discover AI Model Outputs - ATLAS
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001017: Agent — A Material Entity that bears an Agent Capability. [found by 2/2 queries]
  Siblings: portion of pathological body substance, Target, physical sign
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001379: Agent Capability — A Realizable Entity that inheres in a Material Entity in virtue of that Material Entity's capacity to realize it in some Planned Act. [found by 2/2 queries]
  Siblings: Strength, Affordance, plan
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0084.002: Activation Triggers - ATLAS — Adversaries may discover keywords or other triggers (such as incoming emails, documents being added, incoming message, or other workflows) that activate an agent and may cause it to run additional actions.

Understanding these triggers can reveal how the AI agent is activated and controlled. This may also expose additional paths for compromise, as an adversary could attempt to trigger the agent from outside its environment and drive it to perform unintended or malicious actions.
  Siblings: Tool Definitions - ATLAS, Embedded Knowledge - ATLAS

axes.rationale: The risk description specifically mentions 'AI agents' and their compliance, making 'Agent' a highly relevant class.
The risk concerns the tools that AI agents use, which can interact with various systems and services, making 'AI Agent Tools - ATLAS' a relevant class.
